purpose: Provider-neutral planning model. Default numbers are editable planning assumptions, not vendor quotes or approved budgets.

modelUnit.requestDefinition: One monthlyRequest is one accepted intake request, whether it is a cache hit or miss.
modelUnit.retryTreatment: Retry attempts are not new intakes; retryRate and retryAttemptCostKrw fold their expected variable cost into the originating intake.
modelUnit.variableVsFullyLoaded: variableCostPerIntakeKrw excludes allocated fixed monthly cost. fullyLoadedCostPerRequestKrw includes fixed monthly cost and is the owner Go/No-Go cost-per-intake metric.

latencyMetric.cohort: Accepted explicit generate actions on the uncached generation path.
latencyMetric.startsAt: Generate action accepted by the backend.
latencyMetric.endsAt: The request reaches generationState proposal or failed.
latencyMetric.scenarioValueStatus: Editable planning assumption, not calculated from component costs and not measured SLO evidence. Replace with canary telemetry before real-provider Go.

ownerThresholdSemantics.maxCostPerSavedFlowKrw: Compare with costPerSavedFlowKrw; fixed monthly cost is included.
ownerThresholdSemantics.maxCostPerFirstCompletedItemKrw: Compare with costPerFirstCompletedItemKrw; fixed monthly cost is included.
ownerThresholdSemantics.maxP95LatencySeconds: Compare with measured uncached generation p95 using latencyMetric start/end/cohort; scenario p95LatencySeconds is only a placeholder until canary telemetry exists.

requiredControls: canonical URL cache and snapshot hash reuse
LLM call only for semantic ambiguity
attempt-level token, cost, latency, and fallback metrics
per-user rate limit and daily/monthly budget
deterministic-only mode and provider kill switch
raw snapshot TTL and storage budget
goNoGoRule: Real-provider production is NO-GO while any ownerDecisionThreshold is null or provider pricing/retention has not been refreshed and approved.
